date.as_written: śāke ca vāṇanavasaptacandre pakṣendumāsaś ca khacandratithyam || †rudraś ca tārādri-induyoge khaṃ candravārāddhi ṛtau ca cakṣuḥ†

notes: Chronogram in Śaka: vāṇa (5) - nava (9) - sapta (7) - candra (1) = ŚS 1795. The phrasing 'idaṃ pustakam vāṇivilāsasarmaṇā⟨ḥ⟩' could mean 'by Vāṇivilāsa Śarman [written]' or 'this book [belongs to] Vāṇivilāsa Śarman'.
